description: Validate Measurement Protocol events for a web stream before sending them to production, checking event structure and parameters.

inputSchema.description: Request model for validating Measurement Protocol events.

api_secret.description: Required. The API secret from Google Analytics for the Measurement Protocol.
api_secret.title: Api Secret

client_id.description: Required. Unique client identifier. This uniquely identifies a user instance of a web client.
client_id.title: Client Id

consent.description: Optional. The consent state for the user.
consent.title: Consent

events.description: Required. Array of events to validate. Each event must have a 'name' field and optional 'params' object.
events.title: Events

measurement_id.description: Required. The measurement ID for web streams. Format: G-XXXXXXXXXX where X is alphanumeric.
measurement_id.title: Measurement Id

timestamp_micros.description: Optional. A Unix timestamp (in microseconds) for the time to associate with the event.
timestamp_micros.title: Timestamp Micros

user_id.description: Optional. A unique identifier for a user.
user_id.title: User Id

user_properties.description: Optional. The user properties for the measurement.
user_properties.title: User Properties

inputSchema.title: ValidateEventsRequest

name: validate_events

ValidateEventsResponse.description: Response model for validating Measurement Protocol events.

validationMessages.description: List of validation messages indicating any issues with the event payload. Empty list means validation passed.
validationMessages.title: Validation Messages

ValidateEventsResponse.title: ValidateEventsResponse

description.description: A human-readable description of the validation issue.
description.title: Description

fieldPath.description: The field path within the request that has the validation issue.
fieldPath.title: Field Path

validationCode.description: The validation code identifying the type of issue.
validationCode.title: Validation Code
